subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Flower of Life
description: A 60-second lesson on The Flower of Life.

hook.text: Nineteen overlapping circles form the Flower of Life—carved in Egyptian temples 6,000 years ago.

buildup.text: The pattern appears in China, India, Turkey, and Italy. Different cultures, same geometric flower.

discovery.text: Inside it, you can find the Platonic solids, Metatron's Cube, and the Tree of Life. Layers within layers.

twist.text: New Age culture claims it's a cosmic blueprint. Mainstream math says it's just efficient circle-packing.

climax.text: Whether sacred or geometric accident, the Flower of Life proves that patterns seduce the human mind.

quiz.question: What shapes can be found within the Flower of Life?
options: The Platonic solids and Tree of Life
